ui_bugs.issue: On Pro user dashboard, the Standard pill background renders amber (rgb(245,159,10)) at the same time as the Hybrid pill background (rgb(238,154,11)) — both look 'active' visually, even though Hybrid is the actual selected mode. Likely cause: initial render flash where state defaults to 'standard' before user-plan resolves and flips it to 'hybrid', OR a CSS hover/focus state lingering. Functionally Hybrid IS the value (verified mode-hybrid star marker present and click actions use hybrid), but the dual-amber appearance is misleading and the visual 'active state' should be exclusive to one pill.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/analysis.py — mode validation, plan gating, and dispatch are clean. Gate (lines 65-71) correctly short-circuits BEFORE quota enforcement and any yfinance/LLM calls — important because it means free-user 402s don't waste API budget. Good.

routers/analysis.py line 122: doc['candlestick_findings'] = candlestick_findings is set AFTER {**analysis} spread, so even if the AI accidentally returned a candlestick_findings key in its JSON, it would be overwritten by the canonical scanner output — desirable.

services/candlestick.py — pure-Python scanner is well-structured, deterministic, and has no external deps. Already covered by 11/11 tests in test_candlestick.py per main agent. The scan_daily_and_weekly weighted combined_bias (60% daily / 40% weekly) is a reasonable default but is a magic number — consider extracting to a constant for tunability.

AnalysisModeSelector.jsx — locked Pro pills have disabled=true AND cursor:not-allowed AND title='requires Pro/Elite'. Triple-coverage is good for accessibility. Lock icon + reduced opacity make it visually obvious. ★ marker on Hybrid for the recommended badge is a nice touch.

CandlestickFindings.jsx — gracefully handles findings=null (returns null), zero-pattern case (renders 'No qualifying patterns' note), and missing summary (omits How-AI-used block). data-testid coverage is excellent (candlestick-findings-module, candlestick-daily-column, candlestick-weekly-column, candlestick-summary-block, pattern-row-{name}). Good.

Backward compatibility verified: GET /api/analysis/AAPL/latest returns the legacy doc with no 'mode' key and no 'candlestick_findings' — and the UI correctly does NOT render the section, instead just shows the mode selector. Excellent backward-compat handling.
_public_view (line 387) correctly forwards mode/candlestick_summary/candlestick_findings to public share endpoint, so shared verdicts will render the candlestick UI for hybrid analyses. Good.

rca of the issue: Dual-amber pill issue: AnalysisModeSelector on DashboardPage receives `value` and `canPro` from parent state. On first paint, DashboardPage's analyzeMode state likely defaults to 'standard' (synchronous initialState), then once the user's plan loads asynchronously and resolves canPro=true, the parent flips analyzeMode to 'hybrid'. During the brief render-flush, both pills may share the active background, OR the screenshot capture happened mid-transition. Reproduction via test confirmed both pills had near-identical amber rgb (245,159,10) and (238,154,11) — slightly different rgbs suggest these may actually be different css vars (--hold vs --warning?) rather than a flash. Suggest: in DashboardPage, gate the AnalysisModeSelector mount on `userLoaded && canPro!==undefined` (e.g., {user && <AnalysisModeSelector ...>}) to prevent the initial 'standard' flash; or compute initial analyzeMode synchronously from userPlan rather than via useEffect.
